name: cleaner-tool-lines
description: Draws each tool call as one line, so the conversation reads straight through. Click a line to open the call.

collapse.title: Collapse tool calls
collapse.description: Fold the tool calls Claude makes in a row into one line that counts them by tool. Click the line to list them. Off, every call has its own line.

showRunning.title: Show the running tool call
showRunning.description: While Claude is still making calls, the collapsed line shows the latest one. Off, it shows the count alone. Has no effect unless tool calls are collapsed.
